honest_limits: Visual scoring ke liye vision input chahiye — harness abhi text-only hai, image-input slice post-testing build hai. Jab tak vision wiring nahi, visual scores Playwright screenshots + ali ki aankh se aate hain, model ki dekh kar nahi.
Pehla full run capable key ke baad hoga — OpenRouter $5 top-up pending hai.
Rubric internal benchmark hai, universal industry standard nahi. Asal judge ali ka verdict hai.
purpose: World-class website engine ko aik jaisi conditions par test karna, score karna, aur har change ke baad regression check karna. Ye ChatGPT ki 8-test suggestion ka RedCat version hai — portfolio-only flaw fix kar ke: tests RedCat ke asal use cases cover karte hain (portfolio, salon, SaaS, redesign, mobile, memory).
regression_rule: Kisi bhi website skill mein change ke baad: purane 8 tests dobara chalao. Naya total purane total se kam ho to change adopt mat karo — pehle root cause dhoondo (scoring-rubric.md mein root-cause table). Sirf tab adopt karo jab total barhe ya barabar rahe aur koi functional gate fail na ho.
rules: Har test mein same input, same reference assets, same evaluation conditions.
Har test ka prompt neeche diya gaya exact prompt hai — badlo mat, warna scores compare nahi honge.
Har test ke baad score sheet bharo (results/ mein) — score + ali ka verdict, dono.
Functional gates pass/fail hain: aik bhi gate fail ho to test FAIL hai, score chahe kuch bhi ho.
Kisi bhi skill change ke baad purane 8 tests dobara chalao (regression testing).
Taste ka final judge ali hai — rubric score internal benchmark hai, universal industry standard nahi.
run_procedure: Aik run mein 8 tests, aik hi session mein, aik hi model/key se.
Har test: RedCat ko exact user_prompt do, reference-url wale mein design.md step bhi include hai.
Har test ke baad: Playwright checks (console errors, links, responsive screenshots) + score sheet bharo.
Score sheet: results/YYYY-MM-DD-run-N.md — aik file per run, 8 tests andar.
Ali ka verdict har test par lazmi: pass/fail + aik line kyun.
